title: At the library
steps: You step into the library. There is a smell of old paper, and a great hush fills the room. Through the wall, you can see shelves taller than a house glowing in the morning light.
Welcome. I am Wenna, the librarian. What brings two first-years here so early in the morning?
We have come to borrow wands from the wand bank, please!
The wand bank is at the very far end of the library, at the end of the top aisle. The path goes past many doors, so I will walk with you and teach you a few useful things along the way.
I have opened this door for you, so please come through into the next room! There will be other doors on your way, but those you will have to open yourselves.
This place is amazing! Let us follow her and see what we can learn!
